_annotation.scenario: Operator-trap: a hok-bound capability is in use, but the operator forgot to call `verifier.withNonceStore(...)`. Round 02's defense is silently absent. v0.4's `hasNonceStore()` introspection method now lets operators detect this BEFORE relying on the (non-existent) replay defense. This evidence captures both halves: the gap (replay allowed when no store) and the fix-when-installed (replay denied with the locked reason).
_annotation.detection_mechanism: verifier.hasNonceStore() returns false on the gap-scenario verifier and true on the fixed-scenario verifier. The deployment-readiness postcondition `assert(verifier.hasNonceStore())` catches the forgotten install.
_annotation.finding: Round 08 CLOSED on Run 1 — v0.4's `hasNonceStore()` shipped before this round was authored, so the operator-config gap is detectable from day one. The round documents the failure mode AND validates the fix simultaneously. See docs/purple-team/08-forgot-nonce-store.md.
